task: build a slide presentation in a slides tool (Google Slides, PowerPoint, Canva presentations, Keynote): create from a template or blank, add and edit slides with text and images, apply a theme or layouts, and finish by presenting, sharing, or exporting; complete when present mode, the share confirmation, or the export is shown. Surface pinned: the manual slides-authoring session — AI deck generators (Gamma, Tome, one-click AI features) are OFF-task, as is presentation-skills advice without an authoring session.

tree.label: Create a presentation
tree.note: Prepare 1, then build and revise slides through 2, 3, and 4. Use 5 where motion or interactive navigation is wanted. Review through 6 and return to the relevant editing step. Use 7 for a live or recorded presentation and 8 for saving or sharing the result.
